prompt.content: Who was the Officer Commanding No. 82 Wing when the first F-111Cs landed at Amberley on 1 June 1973?

output: The Officer Commanding No. 82 Wing when the first F-111Cs landed at Amberley on 1 June 1973 was **Major General John W. "Jay" Carter**. He was the Commanding Officer of No. 4 Squadron, Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF), at Amberley Air Base, Queensland.
